title: Choose one skill to practise
description: Select one useful skill and make a small plan to practise it during the month.
steps: Choose one skill that would help in your current work.
Identify one realistic opportunity to practise it.
Reflect briefly on what you learned and what to try next.

title: Share one useful lesson
description: Create a short team moment to share something useful learned from recent work.
steps: Choose a recent lesson, success, or challenge to share.
Invite the team to discuss how the lesson could help future work.
Agree one small action to test before the next team check-in.
